name: web-orlina-case-study-closing-credits-meet-designers
title: Orlina case study closing: 'Meet Designers' portrait cards and a gold 'Thanks for watching'
whatItIs: A dark brown closing slide with a script-and-serif 'Meet Designers' heading, a small 'Artists' pill, two rounded photo cards of the designers in matching orange scarves with their names and role, and a large gold 'Thanks for watching' with 'Appreciate your feelings' below, over a faint radial grid.
whatItMeans: Personal and gracious; naming and picturing the team closes the story on a human note.
techniques: Show both designers in matching styling for cohesion.
Fade a radial grid behind the sign-off.
Pair a script word with serif italics in the thank-you.

vocabulary.definition: Concentric lines fading from a centre point.
The closing message of a presentation.
